_about: J. Gresham Machen (1881-1937), professor at Princeton and founder of Westminster Seminary: The Literature and History of New Testament Times (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board, 1915); The Origin of Paul's Religion (New York: Macmillan, 1923 printing of the 1921 Sprunt Lectures); Christianity and Liberalism (New York: Macmillan, 1923); What is Faith? (London: Hodder and Stoughton; the undated British issue, printed in Britain, of the book Macmillan copyrighted in the US in 1925). All are US publications before 1930, so public domain in the US. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

machen-literature-history-1915: The Literature and History of New Testament Times (Philadelphia, 1915)
machen-origin-pauls-religion: The Origin of Paul's Religion (New York: Macmillan, 1921; this copy printed 1923)
machen-what-is-faith-1925: What is Faith? (London: Hodder and Stoughton, undated British issue; US copyright 1925 by Macmillan)
